title: Splint Mould
summary: Mould for forging Adamantine Splint Armour.

fields.Forge: Use the Splint Mould and Mithral Ore at the Adamantine Forge in Grymforge. Activate the lava valve and forge hammer.
fields.Acquisition: Rock ledge near the Ancient Forge waypoint at (−593, 311).

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
